_comment: One entry per company/practice. frontInboxId and xeroTenantId are identifiers, not secrets. status: off = never touched; dry_run = may be scanned and dry-run (reads only), never written to or scheduled; live = included in the daily schedule and execute runs. A company that is not off must have its Xero tenant ID and name. Each Front inbox may only ever write to its own Xero organisation; xeroTenantName must match the organisation name Xero reports exactly. VAT treatment for each inbox is set in coding-policies.json.
